blocks.prompt: 4. Find an equation of the graph which touches x-axis at \(x = -1\) and cuts y-axis at \(y = -2\).
blocks.explanation:
Sawal mein do ahem alfaaz hain: 'touches' aur 'cuts'.
'x-axis ko \(x = -1\) par chhoota hai' ka matlab hai ke \(x = -1\) repeated root hai, yani \(y = a(x + 1)^{2}\).
'y-axis ko \(y = -2\) par kaatta hai' ka matlab hai ke point \((0, -2)\) graph par hai.
Yahi point \(a\) dega. Plan: Case-II ki form likhna, point rakhna, expand karna aur check karna.
steps:
Diya gaya: graph x-axis ko \(x = -1\) par chhoota hai aur \((0, -2)\) se guzarta hai.
Maloom karna: graph ki equation.
Tareeqa: repeated factor \(y = a(x - h)^{2}\), jahan \(h = -1\) (1.1 ka Case-II); phir \((0, -2)\) rakhenge.

Factor form likhein
\[y = a(x + 1)^{2} \quad \text{...(1)}\]
Kyun: jo graph x-axis ko \(x = h\) par sirf chhooye, us mein \((x - h)\) do dafa aata hai. \(h = -1\) se \((x + 1)\) bana.
Dhyan dein: 'touches' ko 'cuts' samajh kar \(a(x + 1)(x - k)\) jaisi form mat likhiye; sirf ek hi root hai.

\(a\) nikalein
\[-2 = a(0 + 1)^{2}\]
\[a = -2\]
Kyun: y-intercept \((0, -2)\) graph par hai; \(x = 0\) rakhne se \((0 + 1)^{2} = 1\) bacha, to \(a = -2\).

Tasdeeq:
\[y(-1) = -2(0)^{2} = 0 \;\checkmark\]
\[y(0) = -2 \;\checkmark\]
\(a < 0\), is liye graph neeche khulta hai aur vertex \((-1, 0)\) us ka sab se ooncha point hai; yani graph x-axis ko chhoo kar wapas neeche jata hai, paar nahi karta. Bilkul sawal ke mutabiq.
